description.en: Prototype of an RPG in Pax Universe: the planet Yuruma instead of Earth, cities on the globe; a click on a city loads its location вЂ” a platform where a simple demon swordsman walks with WASD and draws his katana with F; the gate leads back to the world map. Scenario В«YurumaВ»: year 1047 of the Shattered Sky, five empires, own map of 420 provinces.
